title: factory.merge-applied/v1 output artifact — what was actually applied

repo.description: Echo of the short repo name from the input

applied.description: Every item that actually merged, in order. Conflicts and stale SHAs are skipped rather than aborting the batch (WM-908).

issueId.description: The item's Linear ticket — the item-list adapter records the item key under the fixed name issueId (lib/adapters/actions.mjs), and merge-apply's itemKey is the ticket

action.description: Registered action id that ran for this item

skipped.description: Plan items that were not merged, with a reason, so the next plan cycle can retry them
